content.title: Semantic Type Physics | Phrase Escalation to Sentence Lockup
content.summary: Divide one original sentence into an ordered series of semantic phrases, interpreting each through a different but connected material, space, and motion behavior. Escalate energy and scale step by step, then stop all motion and reassemble the complete sentence into a readable terminal state.

quick_start.input_format: original complete sentence + fixed semantic segmentation + readable type and distinct physical behavior per phrase + continuous carrier handoff + controlled escalation + static full-sentence lockup
quick_start.recommended_input: On a deep charcoal background, one signal-green navigation point appears as the white condensed uppercase words SMALL SIGNALS assemble accurately. Ripples extend into three luminous paths through a translucent mineral map; SHARED grows heavier as distributed paths connect to its letters. All routes stop and the complete sentence Small signals become shared direction. appears centered, with signals and direction in signal green and the remaining words in black.
required_anchors: Begin with one original sentence divided into a fixed semantic order; reveal the first phrase from a minimal baseline.
Give every new phrase one readable typographic state and one physical behavior tied to its semantic role.
Escalate at least two of scale, contrast, spatial depth or motion energy in a controlled sequence.
Stop the escalation and reassemble the complete sentence in a stable readable final hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Divide one original sentence into an ordered series of semantic phrases, interpreting each through a different but connected material, space, and motion behavior. Escalate energy and scale step by step, then stop all motion and reassemble the complete sentence into a readable terminal state.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.

Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Split one original sentence into ordered semantic phrases. Give each phrase one legible typographic state and one physical operation that expresses its meaning, while preserving a visible carrier from the previous phase. Increase contrast, spatial scale and motion energy in controlled steps, then reverse the priority at the end: stop all movement, restore the full sentence and hold it long enough to read. The reusable mechanism is semantic phrase-to-physics escalation followed by complete-language lockup, not the source quotation, fonts, palette or exact effects.

invariants.purpose: Maintains one continuous argument across changing designs.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent title cards become an unrelated typography reel.

invariants.purpose: Builds retention and makes the terminal maximum earned.
invariants.ablation_failure: Equal-intensity phases flatten the arc; simultaneous excess becomes chaotic.
